question: Is this Lightning web component the same across orgs, file by file?

steps.name: bundle
steps.soql: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, MasterLabel, ApiVersion, IsExposed, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LightningComponentBundle WHERE DeveloperName = '{name}'

steps.name: files
steps.soql: SELECT FilePath, Format, LastModifiedDate, Source FROM LightningComponentResource WHERE LightningComponentBundleId IN ({@bundle.Id}) ORDER BY FilePath
